veganBeansGuide.title: The Great Vegan Bean Book: Plant-Based Protein & Delicious Dishes
veganBeansGuide.description: Comprehensive guide to beans, legumes, and pulse cooking for plant-based nutrition
veganBeansGuide.introduction: Beans and legumes are nutritional powerhouses: high in protein, fiber, and essential micronutrients. This guide covers bean varieties, cooking methods, and how to incorporate beans into delicious, satisfying meals.

beanCookingMethods.name: Stovetop Cooking (Traditional)

steps.detail: Remove rocks or debris; rinse until water runs clear
8 hours or overnight in 3 parts water to 1 part beans
steps.benefit: Reduces cooking time 20-30%; reduces gas-causing compounds; improves digestibility

steps.detail: Always discard soaking water (where gas-causing compounds leach)
3 parts water to 1 part dried beans
High heat for 2 minutes (helps remove gas-causing compounds)
Remove white foam that rises (oligosaccharides causing gas)
Beans should be tender when squeezed between fingers
Add salt only when beans are almost done (prevents toughening)

beanCookingMethods.advantage: Full control; can season broth; energy efficient

beanCookingMethods.name: Pressure Cooker (Fast)
steps: Soak 4-8 hours if desired (reduces cooking time further)
Add drained beans + 3 parts water to pressure cooker
Cook 20-30 minutes depending on bean type
Allow pressure to release naturally 10 minutes
Check doneness; cook longer if needed

beanCookingMethods.name: Slow Cooker (Low and Slow)
steps: Add soaked beans (or unsoaked + extra water)
Add 3-4 parts water to 1 part beans
Cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours
Check for doneness; cook longer if needed
beanCookingMethods.advantage: Set and forget; develops deep flavors

beanCookingMethods.name: Canned Beans (Convenience)
preparation: Rinse thoroughly (removes up to 40% of sodium)
Use 1 can (about 1.5 cups cooked) as equivalent to 1/2 cup dried
beanCookingMethods.nutrition: Similar nutritionally to home-cooked (though slightly softer texture)

solutions.method: 8 hours+ in water; discard soaking water
When bringing to boil, skim white foam
Start with small amounts; increase over weeks
solutions.benefit: Gut bacteria adapt to bean digestion

solutions.method: Soak 12-24 hours until small sprout appears

solutions.note: Lentils and split peas cause less gas than dried beans

examples: Rice and beans (any color bean + rice)

beanRecipes.name: Classic Black Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 cans black beans (or 1 cup dried, cooked)
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, carrot in olive oil until soft (5 minutes)
Add cumin and chili powder; cook 1 minute
Add beans and broth
Bring to simmer; cook 15-20 minutes
Mash some beans to thicken soup (optional)
Season with salt, pepper, lime juice
Garnish with cilantro

beanRecipes.name: Creamy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Combine chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic in food processor
Blend until smooth (may take 2-3 minutes)
Add water gradually until creamy consistency
Drizzle with olive oil
Sprinkle with paprika
Serve with vegetables, pita, or crackers

beanRecipes.name: Lentil Curry
instructions: Heat oil; sauté onion, garlic, ginger (5 minutes)
Add spices; cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add lentils, coconut milk, broth
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 15-20 minutes
Lentils should be soft but not mushy
Stir in spinach; cook until wilted
Season with salt, lime juice
Serve over rice or with naan

storageAndPreservation.storage: Cool, dry place in airtight container
